fact: The malaria programme's bulletin gives national completeness of the data entered in DHIS2 for January to December 2023 as 26.66 per cent and promptness as 10.28 per cent, on an extraction of 31 January 2024, with a table by region, and attributes the level to the care providers' strike and retention of health data in 2023; it reports completeness, not the number of facilities keying their own reports.
title: Bulletin épidémiologique annuel 2023 du paludisme au Sénégal
publisher: Programme National de Lutte contre le Paludisme
